articles.title: Plume affiliate lands broker-dealer license to bring real U.S. assets onchain
articles.snippet: Kimber Digital Securities secured SEC and Finra approvals, a regulatory milestone paving the way for the delivery of legally binding claims, dividends, and yield-bearing products directly to self-custodial wallets and stablecoin applications in the U.S.

articles.title: North Korean hackers create memecoins to launder funds from Binance hack: Elliptic
articles.snippet: The blockchain firm traced stolen funds through six new tokens on NEAR, where hackers used liquidity pools to obscure transfers between wallets.

articles.title: Nvidia Erases 2026 Gains as Republicans Threaten Jensen Huang With Subpoena
articles.snippet: The chipmaker has erased its 2026 gains as a suspected Chinese espionage case brings fresh scrutiny of CEO Jensen Huang.

articles.title: Nvidia, Jensen Huang Sued by Shareholders Over Alleged Ties to Suspected Chinese Spy
articles.snippet: A proposed class action claims the chipmaker misled investors about the CEO's alleged affair and the national security risks it posed.

articles.title: Google Takes Aim at Nvidia With New AI Chips Built for Privacy and Massive Memory
articles.snippet: Google’s TPU 8tx protects sensitive AI workloads, while the dual-chip TPU 8i Max targets memory-hungry AI agents.
